en.t: Her reply poem was as follows.

units.source_text: 皇后与紫姬才华均甚优越。

en.t: The empress and Lady Murasaki were both exceedingly gifted.

units.source_text: 但恐皇后于诗道不甚擅长，此赠答之诗，未得称为佳作也。

en.t: But perhaps the empress was not especially skilled in the way of poetry, for these exchange poems could not be called fine works.
